description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest' that tests the behavior of the 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy' class, ensuring it correctly purges employee data fields with different formatting strategies. It sets up test data, runs purge operations, and verifies the results and related strategy retrieval methods.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy' class, testing purge functionality, record purging, and strategy retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, populates test data from YAML fixture, and instantiates the purge strategy object.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Verifies the purge operation modifies Employee fields to expected values.

methods.name: testPurgeRecord
methods.description: Checks that purging an Employee record updates its fields correctly in the database.

methods.name: testGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Ensures the correct instance types are returned for various strategy names.

methods.name: invokeProtectedGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected 'getReplaceStrategy' method using reflection.
